title: Single Dimension Shulker Farm [1.17 Java Edition]
description:
For so long I admantly refused to believe that a single dimension shulker farm would ever be viable. So I decided I would try and actually build one to demonstrate how terrible they are, however I was pleasantly suprised to find that with a few innovations the farm produces a decent 160 shells per hour.

PLEASE NOTE, the litematic has been updated to the shulker farm Mk2 which fixes a few issues with the minecart collection and also obtains slightly higher rates at 182/h!!!
